title: Knowledge
tagline: Pramana — the light of true understanding

sections.theme: Knowledge comes from i) direct perception, ii) inference ...

sutra.meaning: Knowledge comes from i) direct perception, ii) inference or deduction,iii) scriptural testimony.

sections.insight: Direct experience is most powerful. To be in meditation one should decide not to dwell on any logic or be interested in any proof.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Do I feel a need to be correct or logical all the time? Am I judgemental?
sections.practice:
Observe thoughts without reacting
Do I rely on experience or assumption?
sections.meditation:
3 min reflection
Observe - how do I form  my opinions. 10 min meditation

sections.theme: Wrong or perverse knowledge is false understanding based ...

sutra.meaning: Wrong or perverse knowledge is false understanding based on what is not a fact or real.

sections.insight: Many beliefs are based on incomplete perception. For instance a person suffering inferiority complex may find others behavior arrogant.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Which of my beliefs may be wrong?
sections.practice: Question one of your assumptions today. Think deeply.

sections.theme: Imagination is based on mere words not based on reality

sutra.meaning: Imagination is based on mere words not based on reality

sections.insight: The mind creates stories without facts. Sometimes its mere pleasureable fantasy but at other times it could be baseless fears.
sections.reflectionPrompt: What story did my mind create?

sections.theme: Sleep is a mental state based on absence of thought or kn...

sutra.meaning: Sleep is a mental state based on absence of thought or knowledge.

sections.insight: When the mind is not seeking proof or deluding or making up stories, it is asleep.
sections.journalPrompt: How does rest or lack thereof affect me?

sutra.sanskrit:
तत्र निरतिशयं सर्वज्ञबीजम्
स पूर्वेषामपि गुरुः कालेनानवच्छेदात
sutra.meaning:
In Ishvara lies infinite knowledge
The divine is the eternal teacher

sections.insight:
The source of knowledge is within.
Wisdom is timeless.
